Terrain Theory Protocol (Darkfield Microscopy-Guided)

Therapy terrain-theory darkfield microscopy pleomorphism blood-analysis

Evidence: opinion

Summary

Terrain theory approach using darkfield microscopy to observe live blood, identifying pleomorphic forms and guiding treatment. Focuses on optimizing the internal terrain (pH, oxygenation, mineral balance) rather than pathogen elimination alone.

Type: terrain

Benefits

  • Live blood analysis
  • Terrain optimization
  • Personalized treatment protocols
  • Mineral balancing
  • pH regulation

Contraindications

  • Severe mental health crisis (interpretation anxiety)
  • Bleeding disorders (blood draw)

Session Duration: 30-60 minutes for initial consultation and analysis

Frequency Recommendation: Initial consultation, follow-up every 3-6 months

Cost Range: $150-400 per session
